title: The Law of Small Numbers
coreMove: withhold pattern claims until the sample is large enough to deserve them
sourcePressure: shows that people expect stable patterns from samples far too small to justify confidence
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: calling every small sample useless instead of seeing how noise masquerades as signal
